summary: Iteration 6: Verified NEW public live-telemetry overlay feature (backend WS + REST + React overlay page + admin dashboard link card) + full regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_overlay.py with 3 tests: (1) GET /api/overlay/state returns type='telemetry' + all 10 fields with no auth (200). (2) WS /api/ws/overlay connects with no auth and immediately pushes an initial telemetry frame. (3) End-to-end relay test: created access code, connected control WS, sent set:depth:70, set:stroke:55, set:sensation:40, set:speed:95 with max_speed=70 -> overlay frame shows speed=70 (CLAMPED), depth=70, stroke=55, sensation=40, running=true, controller='TEST_OV_RELAY'; GET /api/overlay/state matches. After ~2s, run_seconds >= 2 and session_seconds >= 2. After set:speed:0, running=false and run_seconds stops growing. On guest WS disconnect, overlay frame resets: speed/depth/stroke/sensation=0, controller=null, run_seconds=0. Full regression suite: 47/47 passed in 45.7s (27 backend_test + 10 twofa + 7 lockout + 3 overlay). Frontend Playwright via external URL: /overlay page renders overlay-root + overlay-runtime + overlay-session + overlay-status + 4 metric panels (speed/depth/stroke/sensation) each with overlay-value-<k> and SVG sparkline; status pill shows 'NO DEVICE' when no host connected (correct - LIVE only requires host_connected). Drove a real guest via WSS from a browser page: overlay-value-speed=80, depth=60, stroke=45, sensation=35, controller='TEST_UI_OVERLAY', runtime advanced to 00:03, sparkline polyline points grew from 137 -> 190 chars proving graphs are moving. /overlay?transparent=1 sets root style.background='transparent' as expected. AdminDashboard overlay-link-card present with copy-overlay-link + open-overlay-link (href='/overlay'). CLEANUP done: deleted all TEST_* access codes, reset safety limits to {0,100}, telemetry idle.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Hub telemetry is fully in-memory (single active slot) which matches the app's single-device model. reset_telemetry() correctly called on promote() and end_active(); push_telemetry() called in handle_command (after clamp) and in ticker tick — so overlay updates without host being connected. Good.
Overlay WS discards dead sockets on send failure; no auth needed by design (public OBS overlay). If future public exposure is a concern, consider a short opaque token or origin allowlist.
clamp_command runs before hub.telemetry is updated, so overlay always reflects the actual value sent to host (post-clamp). Matches spec.
telemetry_frame: run_seconds computed from motion_accum + delta since motion_start (only while speed>0); session_seconds derived from active_start monotonic — no clock drift issues.
Sparkline.jsx: pushes at fixed 500ms cadence with 120-point cap (~60s window). Uses drop-shadow filter for glow — nice touch.
Overlay.jsx: reconnects WS after 1.5s on close — good resilience; no auth in URL is by design.

Minor: overlay-status shows 'LIVE' only when host_connected. When there is no BLE host but a guest is driving (test env), pill stays 'NO DEVICE' — this is correct per agent note, worth documenting in the UI copy so users don't think overlay is broken.
backend_test.py already keeps ws://localhost:8001 for WebSockets (external ingress WS uses wss on 443 which also works but slower); consistent with prior iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (overlay renders, live values update, sparkline moves, transparent mode works, admin card OK)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test created and deleted access codes (TEST_OV_RELAY, TEST_UI_OVERLAY, plus stale TEST_* codes from earlier iterations); safety limits temporarily set to {0,70} then restored to {0,100}.
